review_mode.method: independent schema, canonical digest, selected-byte, cross-binding, registry and claim-boundary recomputation; short-interval protected-byte snapshots

protected_snapshot.algorithm: sort unique repository-relative paths; for each path concatenate path, NUL, SHA256(whole-file bytes), newline; SHA256 the UTF-8 concatenation
protected_snapshot.scope_note: Stability over the short snapshot interval only; not an entire-run lock or future-currentness guarantee.
